renderingPolicy.availability: Section level, independent of display-family membership.
renderingPolicy.holdings: Derive current confirmed holdings from live canonical identity links; this reference JSON never creates or increments inventory counts.
renderingPolicy.missingIdentities: Five missing individual Guru identities are context-only, no nonexistent profile links.
renderingPolicy.identityChanges: Reconcile optional canonicalSaintId against current website state; do not fuzzy-match or substitute the composite Ram Das/Arjan record.
renderingPolicy.canonicalDeduplication: Merge saved canonical edges by exact endpoints and semantic type; do not display duplicate Arjan-Hargobind, spouse or disciple edges.
renderingPolicy.succession: Keep all nine immediate successor edges; filtered/missing context must not produce false direct edges.
renderingPolicy.source291: Combined Ram Das/Arjan source row remains unresolved and is not a second confirmed Arjan holding.
renderingPolicy.piara: Affiliation edge terminates at non-person context node, never a historical Guru.
renderingPolicy.planning: No effect on sections, tiers, areas, destinations, family membership or physical inventory.
